# AOSP audio effect AIDL — NDK client code

NDK C++ code for talking to the device's AIDL audio effect HAL
(`android.hardware.audio.effect.IFactory/default`) from the Bluetooth process.

- `aidl/`: frozen AIDL API snapshots from AOSP `refs/heads/main` (fetched 2026-11-25), Apache-2.0:
  - `effect3`: `hardware/interfaces/audio/aidl/aidl_api/android.hardware.audio.effect/3`
  - `acommon4`: `hardware/interfaces/audio/aidl/aidl_api/android.hardware.audio.common/4`
  - `fmq1`: `hardware/interfaces/common/fmq/aidl/aidl_api/android.hardware.common.fmq/1`
  - `common2`: `hardware/interfaces/common/aidl/aidl_api/android.hardware.common/2`
  - `types4`: `system/hardware/interfaces/media/aidl_api/android.media.audio.common.types/4`
  - `eraser1`: `system/hardware/interfaces/media/aidl_api/android.media.audio.eraser.types/1`
- `include/`, `src/`: generated by `generate.sh` (SDK build-tools 37.0.0 `aidl --lang=ndk`).
- `binder_ndk_cpp/android/`: header-only libbinder_ndk C++ helpers and platform declarations from AOSP
  `frameworks/native/libs/binder/ndk/include_cpp` and `include_platform` (Apache-2.0); the NDK sysroot
  only ships the C headers.
